legacy_upgrade.supported_deployment: Stop all old voters, retain disks and configuration, OpenExisting all voters with new binary, complete the old log and ordered activation before business readiness.

membership.single_post_evidence_scope: Frozen harness has one phase-08 POST call and one fetch in its admin adapter; this is application-level invocation evidence, not an independent packet capture.
limits: One local run using loopback network faults and SIGKILL; no independent-AZ, power-loss, production latency/RTO percentile or availability claim.

Phase 08 returned UNKNOWN and later authoritative state contains learner 5; the request was not reported as cancelled or rolled back.

ack_retention.proof_scope: The frozen harness queries current SQL rows and asserts every successful measured write request_id remains present. This review checks its actual completed execution, exact sampled ACK inventory and assertion source; it does not reopen private databases.

limitations: The successful local gates authorize the requested merge; unexecuted remote CI is not claimed to pass.
All daemon experiments used local loopback, process faults and bounded databases; no three-AZ, independent-device power-loss or production availability claim.
The 11,066,060-byte history figure is a conservative observed lower bound; fold-trigger transactions are excluded and every retained delta is bound to the actual next status response.

The membership base-transfer proof composes fresh source bases, later source compaction, actual learner snapshot installation and exact SQL/unique-new-voter-disk recovery. The learner base is not directly introspected.
Actual-old prefix tests and daemon upgrade/snapshot tests are complementary; an old-cluster/new-learner log-only deployment was not separately measured.
No limits were raised: 256 KiB database images, 128 retained request identities per database, 32 configured databases and 4,096 administrative records remain bounded.
Logical outcomes and S3 objects remain retained; result retirement, object GC, PITR, S3-only disaster recovery, dynamic directory and multi-cell scheduling are not implemented here.
Wire generation isolation requires stopping all old voters for this upgrade; mixed-version rolling upgrade and reverse disk-format conversion are unsupported.
The recovery stable-window start is a one-second-resolution single-run observation, confirmed 30 seconds later; it is not an RTO percentile.
Hot-read 50 ms and hot-write 100 ms p99 production targets are not validated by these local samples. Failure samples are retained separately from successful-request latency percentiles.
